Education
======
* **MSc in Robotics (College of Computing)**, Georgia Institute of Technology, Aug 2025 – May 2027 (expected). GPA 3.88/4.0.

Research & Work Experience
======
* **Research Intern**, General Intelligence Machine (GIM) — Jun 2026 – present
  * Core contributor to RoboChrono, a real-robot benchmark for streaming task understanding (39 scenarios, 34.7k instances, 18 VLMs evaluated): led VR-teleop data collection, the annotation/QA protocol, and the VLM evaluation harness.
  * Operate GIM's dual-arm whole-workspace platform with VR teleoperation for data collection and policy evaluation.
* **Graduate Research Assistant**, Georgia Institute of Technology (PI: Prof. Sehoon Ha) — Jan 2026 – present
  * Built a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline (X-Sim style): phone video → COLMAP → 2D Gaussian Splatting → watertight mesh → SAPIEN/ManiSkill scene with CoACD collision and auto-generated URDF.
  * Integrated Gaussian-splat environments into Isaac Lab and a Neuromeka NAMI platform (USD scene swap, Zenoh messaging) for sim-trained grasping policies on a mobile dual-arm robot.
  * Set up Unitree Z1 and G1 developer workflows (SDK build, DDS low/high-level control) and Isaac Lab across lab GPUs.
* **Graduate Research Assistant**, LIDAR Lab, Georgia Institute of Technology (PI: Prof. Ye Zhao) — Aug 2025 – present
  * Co-author of VQActFlow (RA-L, in revision): led LIBERO experiments, Unitree G1 teleop data and deployment, ALOHA-style bimanual experiments, and latency engineering.
  * Reward modeling for VLA post-training: LoRA-finetuned Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for sub-task segmentation and success classification on LIBERO-Spatial; Qwen2.5-VL chain-of-thought reward labeling (criteria → description → analysis → rating).
  * Distilling VLM judgments into lightweight real-time reward models for iterative RL post-training; surveyed and benchmarked recent reward/value-model work (SCORE, ARM, LRM, SARM2, ReTVL, …) and the RBM-1M / Robometer datasets.
  * Ongoing: coffee-agent, a self-evolving agent that learns a pour-over coffee routine on a real robot, with a critic/reward model guiding policy updates during out-of-distribution exploration.
* **Research Scientist Intern**, Shenzhen Shunhe Electric — Jun 2025 – Aug 2025
  * Multi-view video temporal alignment with a Simone-style model and curriculum learning: 99% accuracy on 3-class and >90% on 9-class temporal-offset classification.
  * Explored cross-attention fusion and diffusion decoders for cross-view alignment.
* **Research Assistant (remote)**, ETH Zurich — Sep 2024 – Apr 2025
  * Positional-encoding scheme for lexicographic rule hierarchies in autonomous-vehicle decision making.
* **Research Assistant (remote)**, University of California, Berkeley — Apr 2024 – Sep 2024
  * Graphlet-based bootstrapping for hypothesis testing against network null models.
* **Vision & Autonomy Engineer**, HKUST RoboMaster Team — Sep 2022 – Oct 2023
  * Built the auto-aim pipeline (OpenCV + YOLOv8 on industrial cameras) with predictive target tracking at 7–8 m, improving bullet efficiency by ~80%.
  * Developed the autonomous Sentinel robot: ROS2 + FreeRTOS, LiDAR/IMU/camera sensor fusion for navigation and engagement.
